seite.untertitel: Positioning, skills, career history and references — used for matching and cover letters.

linkedin.text_hinweis: Open your LinkedIn profile in the browser, select everything (Cmd/Ctrl + A), copy it and paste it here. Or upload the PDF that LinkedIn creates with “Save to PDF”. The text goes to your AI, and you check the result before anything is saved.
linkedin.zip_hinweis: LinkedIn → Settings → Data privacy → “Get a copy of your data” → top option “Download larger data archive” (NOT the quick option “Profile”, which only contains the positioning). The large archive covers skills, work experience, education and certifications; LinkedIn can take up to ~24 h to provide it. Additive: importing again does not overwrite anything you have maintained by hand.

vorschau.behalten: Stays as it is because it is already filled in: {{felder}}

positionierung.platzhalter: How do you introduce yourself? Running text — used for matching and cover letters.

basis_cv.hinweis: The templates from which every CV tailored to a job is built. The system picks German, English, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese on its own, to match the language of the job posting. If a French, Italian, Spanish or Portuguese posting has no matching version, it translates nothing, uses the English one (otherwise the German one) and says so in its report. Other languages are kept ready but are not used automatically.
basis_cv.nur_manuell_hinweis: The system picks German, English, French, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese on its own, to match the posting; other languages are kept ready but are not used automatically.
basis_cv.code_fehler: The language code must be two lower-case letters (e.g. de, en, fr).
basis_cv.ueberschreiben_frage: There is already a CV for {{sprache}} dated {{datum}} ({{groesse}}, positions: {{stationen}}). Overwrite? The existing file will be moved to the bin.
basis_cv.loeschen_frage: Move the {{sprache}} base CV to the bin?

karte.hinweis: Name, address, contact details and LinkedIn make up the letterhead of your cover letters and the file names. The AI reads your short profile, target date and constraints as background. The title, level and industry of your target roles are under “Settings” in the search plans.
karte.name: Name (required)
karte.positionierung_platzhalter: e.g. Logistics specialist with a focus on dispatching
karte.aktuell_platzhalter: e.g. Driver at Sample Company Ltd, since 2021
karte.kurzprofil_platzhalter: Two or three sentences about your experience and goals.
karte.listenhinweis: One item per line, starting with “- ”.
karte.rahmen_platzhalter:
- Workplace no more than 30 km from Sampletown.
- Full-time, no night shifts.
karte.gaps_platzhalter: - Little experience in dispatching so far.
